about: Files of old trillion (commit 5dc302be, Trillion-X/trillion main) whose job is this tool's, moved here byte for byte by the old-trillion sweep, under their old paths so they import each other as they did. Only import paths differ: a request for a file this repository already holds names that file. A file that cannot load or pass here yet is held: its name ends in .held (the same bytes). Nothing here is wired into tool-rows.json: wiring a file is adapting it, in a commit that names this receipt.
